note: Built-in jev-cron: a timer/message trigger whose action is chosen by a Jev decision model. The endpoint is deliberately not mutable.

every.description: Timer period: milliseconds or "30s", "5m", "1h", "1d" (minimum 1s). Omit for message-only.

on_message.description: Trigger a decision on every received message (default true).

run_at_start.description: Decide once right after start (default false).

context.description: Static JSON context included in the decision state.

actions.description: 2..32 actions: {id, when, send?: {to, text} | [...], remember?: {}, forget?: []}.

fallback.description: Action id applied when confidence < min_confidence (omit: do nothing).

history.description: Recent decisions included in the state (0..50, default 5).

budget_usd_per_day.description: Stop deciding for the rest of the UTC day once reached.

policy_ir.description: Router policy selecting the decision model (passed through to /v1/decisions).

endpoint.description: Router base URL; must be GENSWARMS_JEV_ENDPOINT or an allowlisted host. Not mutable.
